answer: Identities are weighted by staked value and verified presence, so forging thousands of sybils requires buying real hardware and stake per identity. One concrete protocol: each agent must stake collateral and periodically solve a location-bound proof tied to a physical ridge beacon, where the beacon's signed relic seed changes every epoch. An attacker flooding the meadow of fake accounts must pay full collateral for each, making the cost scale linearly and far exceed any reward, while honest agents recover stake on exit. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
